args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deployment (staged RC v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy). Per the platform runbook, we rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollout completed and was verified: all regions are now running v2.3.0, the service reports healthy=true, and error rate is down to ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production (its staging RC, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy). The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back:** Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified:** checkout-api now reports healthy across all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failure and remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.
